published.source: Regear and rotation round (branch claude/keen-brown-o2g32n-hunter, 2026-10-23): the 8% hit cap gear, re-searched talents and rotations, race sweep (was 969.1)

summary: Beast Mastery with a cat: Bestial Wrath, Frenzy and Unleashed Fury. The pet deals about 21% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Bestial Wrath (0s and 120s), Rapid Fire, racials, Sapper and potions on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +140 ranged attack power) 1.5s before the pull and again in its last 3s; the raid's mark is off
Serpent Sting when it is down (mana >= 30%)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Cat (1.0s) bites and claws on cooldown, Frenzy up about 178 of 180s; Auto Shot throughout
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client has 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143, the server hotfix (the client has 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
The pet takes 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power, its crit and its hit, on its own 254 attack power (beta pet sheets).
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Auto Shot fires through casts and winds up 0.5s, which moving cancels.
Pet consumables are off (Forever pets take no player buffs). They would add 17.
Intimidation is talented but not cast.
Major Frenzy Potion is 25.7 behind Major Mana Potion at 180s.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Costs 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.5 DPS vs Beast Mastery at 120s / 180s / 300s.
Assumed: pet hits scale with attack speed as in Classic. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2.5 (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.
notes: Request is hunter__beast-mastery's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/bm_mark.apl.json (the base APL plus the mark line, tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.huntersMark removed; mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_bm_mark. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_bm, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions.
